title: Composition of coefficientwise Rees maps for commuting closed centres
statement: Let s:S -> V, s prime:S prime -> V prime, and s double prime:S double prime -> V double prime be closed immersions [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Given commuting maps of centres (h,b) and (h prime,b prime), the actual coefficientwise extended-Rees map pairMap [lem-trf-section-rees-base-change-etale] of the composite square equals pairMap(h prime,b prime) followed by pairMap(h,b). No Cartesian or flatness hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Step 3; composition-coherence Step 1; sk-thm-dnc Local construction and Gluing

proof.text:
choose affine opens U in V, U' in V', and U'' in V'' with
U' contained in h inverse U and U'' contained in h' inverse U'. These triples
cover V''. On their Rees charts, pairMap is Spec of extendedReesAlgebraMap.
The identity appLE_comp_appLE identifies the two coefficient maps, and
extendedReesAlgebraMap_comp identifies their Rees extensions. Thus the two scheme
maps agree after every chart map. The relative gluing cover is jointly epimorphic,
so the equality holds globally. The proof uses commuting centres, not flatness,
and therefore includes arbitrary base changes and identity maps.
